questions.q: Which statement best describes HTML?
questions.qAf: Watter stelling beskryf HTML die beste?
options: A programming language with loops and variables
A markup language that tells a browser how to display content
A styling language that sets colours and fonts
The editor used to type web pages
optionsAf: 'n Opmaaktaal wat vir 'n blaaier sê hoe om inhoud te vertoon
'n Stileringstaal wat kleure en lettertipes stel
Die redigeerder waarin webblaaie getik word
questions.explain: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is a markup language that tells a browser how to display content. It is not a programming language. Styling is CSS's job, and Notepad++ is the editor.
questions.explainAf: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is 'n opmaaktaal wat vir 'n blaaier sê hoe om inhoud te vertoon. Dit is nie 'n programmeertaal nie. Stilering is CSS se werk, en Notepad++ is die redigeerder.

questions.q: Which two attributes are compulsory in the tag?
questions.qAf: Watter twee attribute is verpligtend in die -etiket?
questions.explain: src is the path to the image file and alt is the alternative text for blind users, which also shows if the image fails to load. width and height are recommended, not compulsory.
questions.explainAf: src is die pad na die prentlêer, en alt is die alternatiewe teks vir blinde gebruikers, wat ook wys as die prent nie laai nie. width en height word aanbeveel, maar is nie verpligtend nie.

questions.q: A learner wants a list numbered A, B, C. Which opening tag must they use?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder wil 'n lys hê wat A, B, C genommer is. Watter openingsetiket moet die leerder gebruik?
questions.explain: A numbered list is an ordered list, <ol>. type="A" gives capital letters; type="a" would give small letters. <ul> is a bulleted list.
questions.explainAf: 'n Genommerde lys is 'n geordende lys, <ol>. type="A" gee hoofletters; type="a" sou kleinletters gee. <ul> is 'n kolpuntlys.

questions.q: In CSS, which selector should you use to style one specific, unique element on a page?
questions.qAf: Watter CSS-selektor moet jy gebruik om een spesifieke, unieke element op 'n bladsy te stileer?
questions.explain: An ID starts with a hashtag (#) and is unique: use it once per page, for one specific element. A class (starting with a full stop) is reusable, and a tag selector styles every instance of that tag.
questions.explainAf: 'n ID begin met 'n hutsmerk (#) en is uniek: gebruik dit een keer per bladsy, vir een spesifieke element. 'n Klas (wat met 'n punt begin) is herbruikbaar, en 'n etiketselektor stileer elke voorkoms van daardie etiket.

questions.q: A range of 10 cells holds 7 numbers, 2 names and 1 empty cell. What does =COUNTA give for this range?
questions.qAf: 'n Selreeks van 10 selle bevat 7 getalle, 2 name en 1 leë sel. Wat gee =COUNTA vir hierdie reeks?
questions.explain: COUNTA counts every cell that is not empty, text or numbers: 7 + 2 = 9. For the same range COUNT = 7 (numbers only) and COUNTBLANK = 1.
questions.explainAf: COUNTA tel elke sel wat nie leeg is nie, teks of getalle: 7 + 2 = 9. Vir dieselfde reeks is COUNT = 7 (net getalle) en COUNTBLANK = 1.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, …?
questions.explain: The differences are +3, +5, +7, +9, so they go up by 2 each time. The next difference is +11, and 26 + 11 = 37.
questions.explainAf: Die verskille is +3, +5, +7, +9, dus word hulle elke keer 2 groter. Die volgende verskil is +11, en 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.q: Which file does the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) run?
questions.qAf: Watter lêer word deur die Java Virtual Machine (JVM) uitgevoer?
questions.explain: You type the source code in a .java file. The compiler translates it into bytecode and saves it as a .class file, and the JVM runs the .class file.
questions.explainAf: Jy tik die bronkode in 'n .java-lêer. Die samesteller vertaal dit na greepkode en stoor dit as 'n .class-lêer, en die JVM voer die .class-lêer uit.

questions.q: How many degrees of freedom (DOF) does a circle have in a FreeCAD sketch?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel vryheidsgrade (DOF) het 'n sirkel in 'n FreeCAD-skets?
questions.explain: A circle has 3 DOF: two for the position of its centre (horizontal and vertical) and one for its radius. A freely drawn line has 4.
questions.explainAf: 'n Sirkel het 3 DOF: twee vir die posisie van sy middelpunt (horisontaal en vertikaal) en een vir sy radius. 'n Lyn wat vry geteken is, het 4.

questions.q: A 9 V supply is connected across a 300 Ω resistor. What current flows?
questions.qAf: 'n 9 V-bron word oor 'n 300 Ω-resistor gekoppel. Watter stroom vloei?
questions.explain: I = V ÷ R = 9 ÷ 300 = 0.03 A. If you multiplied (9 × 300) you used V = I × R the wrong way round.
questions.explainAf: I = V ÷ R = 9 ÷ 300 = 0,03 A. As jy vermenigvuldig het (9 × 300), het jy V = I × R verkeerd om gebruik.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: The content inside the <head> tag is displayed on the web page.
questions.qAf: Die inhoud binne die <head>-etiket word op die webblad vertoon.
questions.explain: The <head> holds metadata and the <title>, which are not displayed on the page. The title shows in the browser tab. Visible content goes in the <body>.
questions.explainAf: Die <head> bevat metadata en die <title>, wat nie op die bladsy vertoon word nie. Die titel wys in die blaaieroortjie. Sigbare inhoud gaan in die <body>.

questions.q: External CSS is the preferred method, because one .css file can style many pages.
questions.qAf: Eksterne CSS is die voorkeurmetode, omdat een .css-lêer baie bladsye kan stileer.
questions.explain: An external style sheet (e.g. style.css, linked with <link> in the <head>) can style 50+ pages. It is the professional standard. Inline CSS is the worst way.
questions.explainAf: 'n Eksterne stylblad (bv. style.css, gekoppel met <link> in die <head>) kan 50+ bladsye stileer. Dit is die professionele standaard. Inlyn-CSS is die swakste manier.

questions.q: Filtering in Excel deletes the rows that do not meet your criteria.
questions.qAf: Filtrering in Excel skrap die rye wat nie aan jou kriteria voldoen nie.
questions.explain: Filtering only hides the data that does not meet your criteria, using the arrows on the headers. Nothing is deleted.
questions.explainAf: Filtrering versteek net die data wat nie aan jou kriteria voldoen nie, met die pyltjies op die opskrifte. Niks word geskrap nie.

questions.q: Java is case sensitive, so Public and public are not the same.
questions.qAf: Java is hooflettersensitief, dus is Public en public nie dieselfde nie.
questions.explain: Java is case sensitive. The keyword is public with a small p; Public would cause an error.
questions.explainAf: Java is hooflettersensitief. Die sleutelwoord is public met 'n kleinletter p; Public sou 'n fout gee.

questions.q: A Revolve sketch must be a closed shape that stays on one side of the axis.
questions.qAf: 'n Revolve-skets moet 'n geslote vorm wees wat aan een kant van die as bly.
questions.explain: The three rules for a Revolve sketch: one side of the axis only (it may not cross it), fully constrained, and a closed shape with no gaps.
questions.explainAf: Die drie reëls vir 'n Revolve-skets: net een kant van die as (dit mag nie die as kruis nie), volledig beperk, en 'n geslote vorm sonder gapings.

questions.q: A servo motor must be connected to the Arduino through an L293D motor driver.
questions.qAf: 'n Servomotor moet deur 'n L293D-motordrywer aan die Arduino gekoppel word.
questions.explain: A servo is easier to wire than a DC motor: no L293D is needed. It connects to the Arduino's 5 V, GND and a signal pin (the green wire, to a ~ port).
questions.explainAf: 'n Servo is makliker om te bedraad as 'n GS-motor: geen L293D is nodig nie. Dit koppel aan die Arduino se 5 V, GND en 'n seinpen (die groen draad, aan 'n ~-poort).

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each HTML tag in column A with its purpose in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke HTML-etiket in kolom A by sy doel in kolom B.
pairs: A horizontal line that divides sections
A line break, like pressing Enter
Wraps each item in a list
One cell of data in a table
pairsAf: 'n Reëlbreuk, soos om Enter te druk
extra: The main container of a table
questions.explain:
and
are both self-closing.
  • goes inside
      or
        . uses href for the address. sits inside a (table row), which sits inside the container.
questions.explainAf:
en
is albei selfsluitend.
  • gaan binne
      of

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each pillar of computational thinking to its meaning.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke pilaar van berekeningsdenke aan sy betekenis.
pairs: Breaking a complex problem down into smaller, manageable parts
Identifying repeated sequences, trends or logic
Focusing on the important information and filtering out unnecessary detail
A clear, step-by-step set of instructions that solves a problem
pairsAf: Om 'n komplekse probleem in kleiner, hanteerbare dele op te breek
Om herhalende reekse, neigings of logika te identifiseer
Om op die belangrike inligting te fokus en onnodige besonderhede uit te filter
'n Duidelike stel stap-vir-stap-instruksies wat 'n probleem oplos
questions.explain: These are the four pillars of computational thinking. A map (roads only, not every blade of grass) is an example of abstraction.
questions.explainAf: Dit is die vier pilare van berekeningsdenke. 'n Kaart (net paaie, nie elke grashalm nie) is 'n voorbeeld van abstraksie.

questions.q: Match each FreeCAD constraint in column A with what it does in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke FreeCAD-beperking in kolom A by wat dit doen in kolom B.
pairs: Forces two lines to meet at exactly 90°
Makes two lines run in the same direction
Fixes a point with a horizontal and a vertical constraint at the same time
pairsAf: Dwing twee lyne om mekaar presies teen 90° te ontmoet
Laat twee lyne in dieselfde rigting loop
Plaas gelyktydig 'n horisontale en 'n vertikale beperking op een punt
extra: Sets the size of a circle or arc
extraAf: Stel die grootte van 'n sirkel of boog
questions.explain: Think of the corner of a book (perpendicular) and railway tracks (parallel). The extra description in column B belongs to the Radius constraint.
questions.explainAf: Dink aan die hoek van 'n boek (loodreg) en spoorlyne (parallel). Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B behoort aan die Radius-beperking.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps in order, from typing a Java program to seeing it run.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe in volgorde: van die tik van 'n Java-program totdat dit uitgevoer word.
steps: Type the source code and save it as MyProgram.java
Click Compile (+): the compiler checks for syntax errors
The compiler saves the bytecode as MyProgram.class
Click Run: the JVM runs the .class file
stepsAf: Tik die bronkode en stoor dit as MyProgram.java
Klik Compile (+): die samesteller soek na sintaksfoute
Die samesteller stoor die greepkode as MyProgram.class
Klik Run: die JVM voer die .class-lêer uit
questions.explain: Source code (.java) → compiler → bytecode saved as .class → the JVM runs it. A syntax error stops the compiler, so no .class file is made until you fix it.
questions.explainAf: Bronkode (.java) → samesteller → greepkode gestoor as .class → die JVM voer dit uit. 'n Sintaksfout stop die samesteller, dus word geen .class-lêer gemaak voordat jy die fout regmaak nie.

questions.q: Put the parts of the Blinky LED circuit in the order the current flows, starting at the Arduino.
questions.qAf: Plaas die dele van die Blinky-LED-stroombaan in die volgorde waarin die stroom vloei, en begin by die Arduino.
questions.explain: The resistor is in series before the LED to limit the current, because an LED has very low internal resistance and would burn out. Current enters the LED at the anode (long leg) and leaves at the cathode to GND.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor is in serie voor die LED om die stroom te beperk, want 'n LED het baie lae interne weerstand en sou uitbrand. Die stroom gaan die LED by die anode (lang been) in en verlaat dit by die katode na GND.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Lerato runs a T-shirt stall at the school market. She types the cost of one shirt (R80) in cell B1. The number of shirts sold each day is in B3 to B12. In C3 she types =B3*B1 to work out the day's takings, then drags the formula down to C12.
questions.scenarioAf: Lerato het 'n T-hempstalletjie by die skoolmark. Sy tik die koste van een hemp (R80) in sel B1. Die getal hemde wat elke dag verkoop is, is in B3 tot B12. In C3 tik sy =B3*B1 om die dag se inkomste te bereken, en sleep dan die formule af tot by C12.

questions.q: In C4 the formula has become =B4*B2, and it shows 0. Why?
questions.qAf: In C4 het die formule =B4*B2 geword, en dit wys 0. Hoekom?
options: B1 is a relative reference, so it moved to B2, which is empty
The formula needs the SUM function
optionsAf: B1 is 'n relatiewe verwysing, dus het dit na B2 geskuif, wat leeg is
Die formule het die SUM-funksie nodig
questions.explain: A relative reference changes with the position of the formula when it is copied. B1 moved down to B2, which is empty, so the answer is 0.
questions.explainAf: 'n Relatiewe verwysing verander saam met die posisie van die formule wanneer dit gekopieer word. B1 het afgeskuif na B2, wat leeg is, dus is die antwoord 0.

questions.q: Which formula should Lerato type in C3 so that it copies down correctly?
questions.qAf: Watter formule moet Lerato in C3 tik sodat dit korrek afgekopieer kan word?
questions.explain: $B$1 is an absolute reference: the dollar signs lock the column and the row, so every row still multiplies by the cost in B1 (=B4*$B$1, =B5*$B$1, …).
questions.explainAf: $B$1 is 'n absolute verwysing: die dollartekens sluit die kolom en die ry, dus vermenigvuldig elke ry steeds met die koste in B1 (=B4*$B$1, =B5*$B$1, …).

questions.q: She selects B1 in the formula and presses F4 twice. What does the reference become?
questions.qAf: Sy kies B1 in die formule en druk F4 twee keer. Wat word die verwysing?
questions.explain: F4 cycles: once gives $B$1 (absolute), twice gives B$1 (row locked), three times gives $B1 (column locked), and four times gives B1 (relative) again.
questions.explainAf: Elke druk op F4 skuif na die volgende opsie: een keer gee $B$1 (absoluut), twee keer gee B$1 (ry gesluit), drie keer gee $B1 (kolom gesluit), en vier keer gee weer B1 (relatief).

questions.q: Which formula shows the most shirts she sold on one day?
questions.qAf: Watter formule wys die meeste hemde wat sy op een dag verkoop het?
questions.explain: MAX gives the largest value in the range. SUM would give the total sold, COUNT how many cells hold numbers, and MIN the smallest value.
questions.explainAf: MAX gee die grootste waarde in die reeks. SUM sou die totaal gee wat verkoop is, COUNT hoeveel selle getalle bevat, en MIN die kleinste waarde.

questions.scenario: Thabo writes this program to make his Gogga, bob, walk around a square.
questions.scenarioAf: Thabo skryf hierdie program om sy Gogga, bob, om 'n vierkant te laat loop.

questions.q: How many times does bob.move() run altogether?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word bob.move() altesaam uitgevoer?
questions.explain: The inner loop moves 3 times for each side, and the outer loop repeats it for 4 sides: 4 × 3 = 12 moves.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste lus beweeg 3 keer vir elke sy, en die buitenste lus herhaal dit vir 4 sye: 4 × 3 = 12 bewegings.

questions.q: How many times does bob turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai bob regs?
questions.explain: bob.turnRight() is inside the outer loop but outside the inner loop, so it runs once per side: 4 times.
questions.explainAf: bob.turnRight() is binne die buitenste lus, maar buite die binneste lus, dus word dit een keer per sy uitgevoer: 4 keer.

questions.q: What does the keyword new do in the first line?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die sleutelwoord new in die eerste reël?
options: It creates (instantiates) the object and runs the constructor
It moves the Gogga one block
optionsAf: Dit skep (instansieer) die objek en roep die konstruktor aan
Dit skuif die Gogga een blok
questions.explain: new instantiates (creates) the object and runs the constructor method: type, name = new Constructor();. The class is the recipe; bob is the cake.
questions.explainAf: new instansieer (skep) die objek en roep die konstruktormetode aan: tipe naam = new Konstruktor();. Die klas is die resep; bob is die koek.

questions.q: Thabo could use the variable name counter for both the inner and the outer loop.
questions.qAf: Thabo kan die veranderlikenaam counter vir die binneste sowel as die buitenste lus gebruik.
questions.explain: The inner and outer loops must use different variable names (here sides and counter), otherwise the computer gets confused.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste en buitenste lusse moet verskillende veranderlikename gebruik (hier sides en counter), anders raak die rekenaar deurmekaar.

questions.scenario: Naledi builds an automatic night light in TinkerCAD. An LDR and a fixed resistor form a voltage divider connected to analog pin A0. An LED with a current-limiting resistor is connected to an output pin. The pin gives 5 V and the LED drops about 2 V. Later she adds a small DC motor to close the curtains.
questions.scenarioAf: Naledi bou 'n outomatiese naglig in TinkerCAD. 'n LDR en 'n vaste resistor vorm 'n spanningsdeler wat aan analoë pen A0 gekoppel is. 'n LED met 'n stroombeperkende resistor is aan 'n uitsetpen gekoppel. Die pen gee 5 V en die LED se spanningsval is ongeveer 2 V. Later voeg sy 'n klein GS-motor by om die gordyne toe te trek.

questions.q: Naledi wants the LED current to be 10 mA (0.01 A). Which resistor does she need?
questions.qAf: Naledi wil hê die LED-stroom moet 10 mA (0,01 A) wees. Watter resistor het sy nodig?
questions.explain: The resistor takes 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0.01 = 300 Ω. (150 Ω is the answer for 20 mA.)
questions.explainAf: Die resistor neem 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0,01 = 300 Ω. (150 Ω is die antwoord vir 20 mA.)

questions.q: In the Read–Process–Act (IPO) cycle, what is the LDR?
questions.qAf: Wat is die LDR in die Lees–Verwerk–Reageer-siklus (IPO)?
questions.explain: The LDR is a sensor: it reads the environment (light), so it is the input. The program is the processing, and the LED is the output (an actuator).
questions.explainAf: Die LDR is 'n sensor: dit lees die omgewing (lig), dus is dit die inset. Die program is die verwerking, en die LED is die uitset ('n aktuator).

questions.q: Analog input turns 0–5 V into a number. Which range of numbers can the reading on A0 have?
questions.qAf: Analoë inset verander 0–5 V in 'n getal. Watter reeks getalle kan die lesing op A0 hê?
questions.explain: Analog input converts 0–5 V to a number from 0 to 1023. Analog output (e.g. LED brightness) accepts 0 to 255.
questions.explainAf: Analoë inset verander 0–5 V in 'n getal van 0 tot 1023. Analoë uitset (bv. LED-helderheid) aanvaar 0 tot 255.

questions.q: She uses the light reading to set the LED's brightness. The reading is 820. What value should she send to the LED after mapping?
questions.qAf: Sy gebruik die liglesing om die LED se helderheid te stel. Die lesing is 820. Watter waarde moet sy ná die afbeelding (mapping) na die LED stuur?
questions.explain: Map 0–1023 to 0–255 by dividing by 4: 820 ÷ 4 = 205. Sending 820 would be far above the maximum of 255.
questions.explainAf: Beeld 0–1023 op 0–255 af deur met 4 te deel: 820 ÷ 4 = 205. 820 self is ver bo die maksimum van 255.

questions.q: Naledi may connect the small DC motor straight to an Arduino pin, because the pin can supply the current the motor needs.
questions.qAf: Naledi mag die klein GS-motor direk aan 'n Arduino-pen koppel, want die pen kan die stroom lewer wat die motor nodig het.
questions.explain: An Arduino pin has an absolute maximum of 40 mA, but even a small DC motor needs about 400 mA, ten times more. It would very likely damage the microcontroller. Use the L293D motor driver as a middleman.
questions.explainAf: 'n Arduino-pen het 'n absolute maksimum van 40 mA, maar selfs 'n klein GS-motor het ongeveer 400 mA nodig, tien keer meer. Dit sou heel waarskynlik die mikrobeheerder beskadig. Gebruik die L293D-motordrywer as tussenganger.
